blocks.text: Tokyo, Japan—Artificial intelligence (AI) has found critical security flaws in a major programming language called PHP, with many websites taken offline Thursday as organisations worldwide scramble to fend off would-be hackers. As AI’s fast-advancing capabilities fuel concern over the increased risk of cyberattacks, here are some questions and answers about the situation: READ: OpenAI says its AI agents disabled their own safety monitors What is PHP and how widely used is it? Created in the early 1990s, PHP is a computer programming language that helps run an estimated 70 percent of the world’s websites. It is “a backbone of the web”, according […]...
